svg.title: Autism screening timeline for young children
svg.desc: A visual timeline showing recommended autism screening milestones at 9, 18, 24, and 36 months, with a message about the importance of early diagnosis.
svg.text: Ask your pediatrician at every well-child visit · 每次健康检查时向儿科医生询问
Early diagnosis before age 3 leads to significantly better outcomes · 3岁前早期诊断能显著改善预后
